title: Chikungunya in Argentina 2026 - by Robert Herriman
snippet:
Latin America and the Caribbean

# Chikungunya in Argentina 2026

Robert Herriman

Since late 2025, an increase in chikungunya fever transmission has been observed in the Region of the Americas, with outbreaks in neighboring countries. In Bolivia, a sustained increase in cases has been recorded, with outbreaks in the border municipalities of Yacuiba and Bermejo (Tarija Department), characterized by high population mobility and frequent transit with northern Argentina. [...] In this context, imported cases have been reported in various jurisdictions in Argentina, and since early January 2026, cases with no travel history have been reported in the province of Salta, with outbreaks in Profesor Salvador Mazza (General José de San Martín Department) and Aguas Blancas (Orán Department). Likewise, at the end of February 2026, confirmed cases with no travel history were reported in Yerba Buena (Tucumán). [...] Cases in Salta

In 2026, up to epidemiological week 8, 36 cases of chikungunya fever were reported, of which 29 are confirmed and seven are classified as probable, distributed in different departments of the province. Compared to the cumulative total reported in the previous epidemiological week, a 177% week-on-week increase in confirmed and probable cases was observed. This increase, due to its rapid growth rate, is consistent with an ongoing outbreak.
